text: Adding 'human' label so do-beads autonomous loop skips this. Same rationale as JMAP-sc1b.77: bead-author explicitly tagged 'opinion / stylistic' and parent JMAP-sc1b is 'human'-labeled. The 'opinion' tag works for bd-review-loop convergence but do-beads only filters on 'human'.
